A prayer for light and well-being
दीपज्योतिः परं ब्रह्म दीपज्योतिर्जनार्दनः ।
दीपो हरतु मे पापं दीपज्योतिर्नमोऽस्तुते ॥
I bow to the sacred flame, a symbol of the divine; may its light dispel darkness and wrongdoing.
